dct_alternative_sm: Alternate supplied title: Massachusetts title collection--cities and towns Lynn 1931-1968--Lynnfield
Alternate supplied title: Massachusetts title collection--drawer 111
dct_description_sm: This record covers single maps of Lynn and Lynnfield, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps may also show different subjects such as landowners or recreation and tourism. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
